verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is documented as a serverless, fully managed cloud data warehouse, and nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of the core service. A local MCP server for 'self-hosted scenarios', local DuckDB development, and bring-your-own object storage for DuckLake are adjacent components or building blocks, not self-hosting of MotherDuck itself. Community posts only ask about on-prem availability or mention a possible offline mode under consideration.
